original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')       and i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)
),
filtered_date_d1 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_warehouse AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_sk
  FROM warehouse w
  INNER JOIN store s ON w.w_state = s.s_state
),
filtered_customer AS (
  SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_current_cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk
  FROM customer c
  INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')
),
web_sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_warehouse_sk
  FROM web_sales ws
  INNER JOIN filtered_item fi ON ws.ws_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_customer fc ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_warehouse fw ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = fw.w_warehouse_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
),
store_sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_quantity
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN filtered_item fi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_date_d1 d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_customer fc ON ss.ss_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
),
joined_sales AS (
  SELECT ssf.ss_customer_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, hd.hd_vehicle_count
  FROM store_sales_filtered ssf
  INNER JOIN web_sales_filtered wsf 
    ON ssf.ss_item_sk = wsf.ws_item_sk
    AND ssf.ss_customer_sk = wsf.ws_bill_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON wsf.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_date_d1 d1 ON ssf.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN customer c ON ssf.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  WHERE d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' day)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM inventory inv
      WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = ssf.ss_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = ssf.ss_sold_date_sk
        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = wsf.ws_warehouse_sk
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ssf.ss_quantity
    )
)
SELECT 
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  hd_vehicle_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM joined_sales
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt;

WITH filtered_date_d1 AS (

),
filtered_web_sales AS (

)
SELECT
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  hd_vehicle_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
  filtered_store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN filtered_date_d1 d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_date_d1 d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' day)
  INNER JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  INNER JOIN inventory inv ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
    AND inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
  INNER JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  INNER JOIN store s ON s.s_state = w.w_state
  INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count

original_query: with customer_total_return as (select sr_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk as ctr_store_sk ,sr_reason_sk as ctr_reason_sk ,sum(SR_REFUNDED_CASH) as ctr_total_return from store_returns ,date_dim where sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year =2001 and sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity between 236 and 295 group by sr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk)  select  c_customer_id from customer_total_return ctr1 ,store ,customer ,customer_demographics where ctr1.ctr_total_return > (select avg(ctr_total_return)*1.2 from customer_total_return ctr2 where ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk ) and ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31 and s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk and s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI') and ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'W') and cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College') and cd_gender = 'M' and c_birth_month = 5 and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956 order by c_customer_id limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
    sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
    SUM(sr_refunded_cash) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM store_returns
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year = 2001
    AND sr_return_amt / NULLIF(sr_return_quantity, 0) BETWEEN 236 AND 295
    AND sr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31
  GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk
),
store_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ctr_store_sk,
    AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS threshold
  FROM customer_total_return
  GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
)
SELECT c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
INNER JOIN store_avg sa ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = sa.ctr_store_sk
INNER JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
INNER JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > sa.threshold
  AND s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI')
  AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
  AND cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College')
  AND cd_gender = 'M'
  AND c_birth_month = 5
  AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956

WITH filtered_customers AS (
  SELECT c.c_customer_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status,
         cd.cd_purchase_estimate, cd.cd_credit_rating, cd.cd_dep_count,
         cd.cd_dep_employed_count, cd.cd_dep_college_count
  FROM customer c
  INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
  WHERE ca.ca_county IN ('Baldwin County','Cocke County','Elko County','Geauga County','Marengo County')
    AND c.c_birth_month IN (6, 7)
    AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('U', 'S')
    AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('Advanced Degree', 'Primary')
    AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
),
store_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002
    AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 6
    AND i.i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 72 AND 81
    AND ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
),
web_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM web_sales ws
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002
    AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 6
    AND i.i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 72 AND 81
    AND ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
),
catalog_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cs.cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002
    AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 6
    AND i.i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 72 AND 81
    AND cs.cs_sales_price / cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
),
web_or_catalog_qualified AS (
  SELECT customer_sk FROM web_qualified
  UNION
  SELECT customer_sk FROM catalog_qualified
)
SELECT fc.cd_gender, fc.cd_marital_status, fc.cd_education_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
       fc.cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) AS cnt2, fc.cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt3,
       fc.cd_dep_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt4, fc.cd_dep_employed_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt5,
       fc.cd_dep_college_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt6
FROM filtered_customers fc
INNER JOIN store_qualified sq ON fc.c_customer_sk = sq.ss_customer_sk
INNER JOIN web_or_catalog_qualified wc ON fc.c_customer_sk = wc.customer_sk
GROUP BY fc.cd_gender, fc.cd_marital_status, fc.cd_education_status,
         fc.cd_purchase_estimate, fc.cd_credit_rating, fc.cd_dep_count,
         fc.cd_dep_employed_count, fc.cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY fc.cd_gender, fc.cd_marital_status, fc.cd_education_status,
         fc.cd_purchase_estimate, fc.cd_credit_rating, fc.cd_dep_count,

WITH date_filter AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq, d_year
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
),
item_filter AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
),
target_week_this_year AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5
  LIMIT 1
),
target_week_last_year AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5
  LIMIT 1
),
common_brand_class_category AS (
  SELECT i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, 'store' AS channel
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN date_filter d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item_filter i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, 'catalog' AS channel
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN date_filter d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item_filter i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, 'web' AS channel
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN date_filter d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item_filter i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  ) all_items
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT channel) = 3
),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_sk
  FROM item_filter i
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM common_brand_class_category c
    WHERE i.i_brand_id = c.i_brand_id
      AND i.i_class_id = c.i_class_id
      AND i.i_category_id = c.i_category_id
  )
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN date_filter ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS list_price
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN date_filter ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_quantity AS quantity, ws_list_price AS list_price
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN date_filter ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  ) x
),
this_year AS (
  SELECT 'store' AS channel,
         i.i_brand_id,
         i.i_class_id,
         i.i_category_id,
         SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,
         COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN item_filter i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM cross_items)
  AND d.d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM target_week_this_year)
  AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
),
last_year AS (
  SELECT 'store' AS channel,
         i.i_brand_id,
         i.i_class_id,
         i.i_category_id,
         SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,
         COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN item_filter i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM cross_items)
  AND d.d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM target_week_last_year)
  AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
)
SELECT this_year.channel AS ty_channel,
       this_year.i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
       this_year.i_class_id AS ty_class,
       this_year.i_category_id AS ty_category,
       this_year.sales AS ty_sales,
       this_year.number_sales AS ty_number_sales,
       last_year.channel AS ly_channel,
       last_year.i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
       last_year.i_class_id AS ly_class,
       last_year.i_category_id AS ly_category,
       last_year.sales AS ly_sales,
       last_year.number_sales AS ly_number_sales
FROM this_year
INNER JOIN last_year
  ON this_year.i_brand_id = last_year.i_brand_id
  AND this_year.i_class_id = last_year.i_class_id
  AND this_year.i_category_id = last_year.i_category_id
ORDER BY this_year.channel, this_year.i_brand_id, this_year.i_class_id, this_year.i_category_id
LIMIT 100;

将target_week_this_year和target_week_last_year改为标量子查询并添加LIMIT 1确保优化器识别为常量，避免CROSS JOIN产生笛卡尔积风险。格式：WHERE d.d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_year=1999 AND d_moy=12 AND d_dom=5 LIMIT 1)。

FROM catalog_sales_filtered UNION ALL SELECT ... FROM web_sales_filtered) GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT channel)=3。避免三次独立的排序去重操作。

WITH filtered_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
),
store_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_items fi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
),
catalog_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_items fi ON cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
),
web_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_items fi ON ws.ws_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_sk AS ss_item_sk
  FROM filtered_items fi
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store_qualified sq WHERE sq.i_brand_id = fi.i_brand_id AND sq.i_class_id = fi.i_class_id AND sq.i_category_id = fi.i_category_id)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_qualified cq WHERE cq.i_brand_id = fi.i_brand_id AND cq.i_class_id = fi.i_class_id AND cq.i_category_id = fi.i_category_id)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_qualified wq WHERE wq.i_brand_id = fi.i_brand_id AND wq.i_class_id = fi.i_class_id AND wq.i_category_id = fi.i_category_id)
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT ss.ss_quantity AS quantity, ss.ss_list_price AS list_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs.cs_quantity AS quantity, cs.cs_list_price AS list_price
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws.ws_quantity AS quantity, ws.ws_list_price AS list_price
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  ) x
),
this_year AS (
  SELECT 'store' AS channel,
         i.i_brand_id,
         i.i_class_id,
         i.i_category_id,
         SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,
         COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN cross_items ci ON ss.ss_item_sk = ci.ss_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 13)
    AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
    AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
),
last_year AS (
  SELECT 'store' AS channel,
         i.i_brand_id,
         i.i_class_id,
         i.i_category_id,
         SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,
         COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN cross_items ci ON ss.ss_item_sk = ci.ss_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 13)
    AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
    AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
)
SELECT ty.channel AS ty_channel,
       ty.i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
       ty.i_class_id AS ty_class,
       ty.i_category_id AS ty_category,
       ty.sales AS ty_sales,
       ty.number_sales AS ty_number_sales,
       ly.channel AS ly_channel,
       ly.i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
       ly.i_class_id AS ly_class,
       ly.i_category_id AS ly_category,
       ly.sales AS ly_sales,
       ly.number_sales AS ly_number_sales
FROM this_year ty
JOIN last_year ly ON ty.i_brand_id = ly.i_brand_id
                  AND ty.i_class_id = ly.i_class_id
                  AND ty.i_category_id = ly.i_category_id
ORDER BY ty.channel, ty.i_brand_id, ty.i_class_id, ty.i_category_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH date_range AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq, d_year
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 49 AND 58
),
intersect_result AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
  FROM filtered_item fi
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_range d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
      AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_range d2 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
      AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_range d3 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
      AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
  )
),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_sk
  FROM filtered_item fi
  JOIN intersect_result ir
    ON fi.i_brand_id = ir.i_brand_id
    AND fi.i_class_id = ir.i_class_id
    AND fi.i_category_id = ir.i_category_id
),
avg_sales_components AS (
  SELECT sum(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sum_ss, count(*) AS cnt_ss
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_range ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
),
avg_sales_cs AS (
  SELECT sum(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sum_cs, count(*) AS cnt_cs
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN date_range ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
),
avg_sales_ws AS (
  SELECT sum(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sum_ws, count(*) AS cnt_ws
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN date_range ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT (sum_ss + sum_cs + sum_ws) / NULLIF(cnt_ss + cnt_cs + cnt_ws, 0) AS average_sales
  FROM avg_sales_components, avg_sales_cs, avg_sales_ws
),
target_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9 THEN d_week_seq END) AS week_this,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9 THEN d_week_seq END) AS week_last
  FROM date_dim
),
this_year AS (
  SELECT 'store' AS channel,
         i_brand_id,
         i_class_id,
         i_category_id,
         sum(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales,
         count(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN filtered_item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  CROSS JOIN target_weeks
  WHERE ss_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM cross_items)
    AND d_week_seq = target_weeks.week_this
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  HAVING sum(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
),
last_year AS (
  SELECT 'store' AS channel,
         i_brand_id,
         i_class_id,
         i_category_id,
         sum(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales,
         count(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN filtered_item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  CROSS JOIN target_weeks
  WHERE ss_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM cross_items)
    AND d_week_seq = target_weeks.week_last
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  HAVING sum(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
)
SELECT this_year.channel AS ty_channel,
       this_year.i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
       this_year.i_class_id AS ty_class,
       this_year.i_category_id AS ty_category,
       this_year.sales AS ty_sales,
       this_year.number_sales AS ty_number_sales,
       last_year.channel AS ly_channel,
       last_year.i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
       last_year.i_class_id AS ly_class,
       last_year.i_category_id AS ly_category,
       last_year.sales AS ly_sales,
       last_year.number_sales AS ly_number_sales
FROM this_year
JOIN last_year
  ON this_year.i_brand_id = last_year.i_brand_id
  AND this_year.i_class_id = last_year.i_class_id
  AND this_year.i_category_id = last_year.i_category_id

WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    ca_state AS ctr_state,
    wr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
    SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM web_returns
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN item ON wr_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_address ON wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  WHERE d_year = 2001
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 69 AND 78
    AND wr_return_amt / wr_return_quantity BETWEEN 28 AND 57
  GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state, wr_reason_sk
),
state_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ctr_state,
    AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_threshold
  FROM customer_total_return
  GROUP BY ctr_state
)
SELECT 
  c_customer_id,
  c_salutation,
  c_first_name,
  c_last_name,
  c_preferred_cust_flag,
  c_birth_day,
  c_birth_month,
  c_birth_year,
  c_birth_country,
  c_login,
  c_email_address,
  c_last_review_date_sk,
  ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
INNER JOIN state_avg sa ON ctr1.ctr_state = sa.ctr_state
INNER JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > sa.avg_threshold
  AND ca_state IN ('IA', 'MT', 'NE', 'TX')
  AND ctr1.ctr_reason_sk IN (3, 31)
  AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag,
         c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address,
         c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100

 ,ws ws3  where     ss1.d_qoy = 1     and ss1.d_year = 2001     and ss1.ca_county = ss2.ca_county     and ss2.d_qoy = 2     and ss2.d_year = 2001  and ss2.ca_county = ss3.ca_county     and ss3.d_qoy =    and ws1.ca_county = ws3.ca_county     and ws3.d_qoy = 3     and ws3.d_year =2001     and case when ws1.web_sales > 0 then ws2.web_sales/ws1.web_sales else null end        > case when ss1.store_sales > 0 then ss2.store_sales/ss1.store_sales else null end     and case when ws2.web_sales > 0 then ws3.web_sales/ws2.web_sales else null end        > case when ss2.store_sales > 0 then WITH ss_base AS (
  SELECT 
    ca_county,
    d_qoy, 
    d_year,
    sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales
  FROM store_sales
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
    AND d_year = 2001 
    AND d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3)
  INNER JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
    AND ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL')
  INNER JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
    AND i_color IN ('purple', 'sandy') 
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 55
  WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 77 AND 91
  GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year
),
ws_base AS (
  SELECT 
    ca_county,
    d_qoy, 
    d_year,
    sum(ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales
  FROM web_sales
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
    AND d_year = 2001 
    AND d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3)
  INNER JOIN customer_address ON ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
    AND ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL')
  INNER JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk 
    AND i_color IN ('purple', 'sandy') 
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 55
  WHERE ws_list_price BETWEEN 77 AND 91
  GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year
)
SELECT 
  ss1.ca_county,
  ss1.d_year,
  ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales AS web_q1_q2_increase,
  ss2.store_sales / ss1.store_sales AS store_q1_q2_increase,
  ws3.web_sales / ws2.web_sales AS web_q2_q3_increase,
  ss3.store_sales / ss2.store_sales AS store_q2_q3_increase
FROM ss_base ss1
INNER JOIN ss_base ss2 ON ss1.ca_county = ss2.ca_county 
  AND ss1.d_year = 2001 AND ss1.d_qoy = 1
  AND ss2.d_year = 2001 AND ss2.d_qoy = 2
INNER JOIN ss_base ss3 ON ss2.ca_county = ss3.ca_county 
  AND ss3.d_year = 2001 AND ss3.d_qoy = 3
INNER JOIN ws_base ws1 ON ss1.ca_county = ws1.ca_county 
  AND ws1.d_year = 2001 AND ws1.d_qoy = 1
INNER JOIN ws_base ws2 ON ws1.ca_county = ws2.ca_county 
  AND ws2.d_year = 2001 AND ws2.d_qoy = 2
INNER JOIN ws_base ws3 ON ws1.ca_county = ws3.ca_county 
  AND ws3.d_year = 2001 AND ws3.d_qoy = 3
WHERE ws1.web_sales > 0 
  AND ss1.store_sales > 0
  AND ws2.web_sales > 0 
  AND ss2.store_sales > 0
  AND ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales > ss2.store_sales / ss1.store_sales
  AND ws3.web_sales / ws2.web_sales > ss3.store_sales / ss2.store_sales
ORDER BY store_q1_q2_increase

    w.w_warehouse_name,
    w.w_warehouse_sk,
    i.i_item_sk,
    d.d_moy,
    inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
  FROM inventory inv
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 1998
    AND d.d_moy IN (2, 3)
    AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 47
    AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 225 AND 425
),
inv_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    w_warehouse_name,
    w_warehouse_sk,
    i_item_sk,
    d_moy,
    STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev,
    AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean
  FROM inv_base
  GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy
),
inv AS (
  SELECT 
    w_warehouse_name,
    w_warehouse_sk,
    i_item_sk,
    d_moy,
    stdev,
    mean,
    CASE WHEN mean = 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev / mean END AS cov
  FROM inv_agg
  WHERE CASE WHEN mean = 0 THEN 0 ELSE stdev / mean END > 1
)
SELECT 
  inv1.w_warehouse_sk,
  inv1.i_item_sk,
  inv1.d_moy,
  inv1.mean,
  inv1.cov,
  inv2.w_warehouse_sk,
  inv2.i_item_sk,
  inv2.d_moy,
  inv2.mean,
  inv2.cov
FROM inv inv1
INNER JOIN inv inv2 
  ON inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk
  AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE inv1.d_moy = 2
  AND inv2.d_moy = 3
  AND inv1.cov > 1.5
ORDER BY 
  inv1.w_warehouse_sk,
  inv1.i_item_sk,
  inv1.d_moy,
  inv1.mean,
  inv1.cov,
  inv2.d_moy,
  inv2.mean,
  inv2.cov;

item_filter as (

  from item
  where i_category = 'Sports' and i_class = 'camping'
),
my_customers as (
  select distinct c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
  from (
    select cs_bill_customer_sk as customer_sk, cs_sold_date_sk as sold_date_sk, cs_item_sk as item_sk
    from catalog_sales
    where cs_wholesale_cost between 18 and 48
      and cs_item_sk in (select i_item_sk from item_filter)
    union all

      and ws_item_sk in (select i_item_sk from item_filter)

  join customer on c_customer_sk = sales.customer_sk
  where c_birth_year between 1932 and 1945
),
date_range as (
  select min(d_month_seq) + 1 as start_seq, min(d_month_seq) + 3 as end_seq
  from date_dim
  where d_year = 2001 and d_moy = 6
),
my_revenue as (
  select c_customer_sk, sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as revenue
  from my_customers
  join store_sales on c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
  join customer_address on c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  join store on ca_county = s_county and ca_state = s_state
  join date_dim on ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk

  FROM date_dim

  LIMIT 1
),
valid_dates AS (

  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_month_seq = (SELECT d_month_seq FROM target_month)
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57
),
filtered_customer AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk, c_birth_year
  FROM customer
  WHERE c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
),
ss_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_id AS item_id,
         fc.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
         SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN valid_dates vd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = vd.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_item fi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_customer fc ON ss.ss_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 269 AND 298
  GROUP BY fi.i_item_id, fc.c_birth_year
),
cs_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_id AS item_id,
         fc.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
         SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  INNER JOIN valid_dates vd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = vd.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_item fi ON cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk

with filtered_promotion as (
  select p_promo_sk
  from promotion
  where p_channel_email = 'Y'
    and p_channel_tv = 'Y'
    and p_channel_radio = 'Y'
),
filtered_item as (
  select i_item_sk, i_product_name
  from item
  where i_current_price between 1 and 11
),
filtered_ad2 as (
  select ca_address_sk, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_city, ca_zip
  from customer_address
  where ca_state in ('GA','IL','OH')
),
filtered_cd1 as (
  select cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
  from customer_demographics
  where cd_marital_status in ('W', 'D')
    and cd_education_status in ('College', '4 yr Degree')
),
filtered_cd2 as (
  select cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
  from customer_demographics
  where cd_marital_status in ('W', 'D')
    and cd_education_status in ('College', '4 yr Degree')
),
cs_ui as (
  select cs_item_sk,
         sum(cs_ext_list_price) as sale,
         sum(cr_refunded_cash+cr_reversed_charge+cr_store_credit) as refund
  from catalog_sales
       join catalog_returns on cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk and cs_order_number = cr_order_number
  where cs_wholesale_cost between 80 and 100
  group by cs_item_sk
  having sum(cs_ext_list_price) > 2*sum(cr_refunded_cash+cr_reversed_charge+cr_store_credit)
),
cross_sales as (
  select i_product_name as product_name,
         i_item_sk as item_sk,
         s_store_name as store_name,
         s_zip as store_zip,
         ad1.ca_street_number as b_street_number,
         ad1.ca_street_name as b_street_name,
         ad1.ca_city as b_city,
         ad1.ca_zip as b_zip,
         ad2.ca_street_number as c_street_number,
         ad2.ca_street_name as c_street_name,
         ad2.ca_city as c_city,
         ad2.ca_zip as c_zip,
         d1.d_year as syear,
         d2.d_year as fsyear,
         d3.d_year as s2year,
         count(*) as cnt,
         sum(ss_wholesale_cost) as s1,
         sum(ss_list_price) as s2,
         sum(ss_coupon_amt) as s3
  from store_sales
       join store_returns on ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk and ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
       join cs_ui on ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
       join filtered_item on ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
       join filtered_promotion on ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
       join store on ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
       join date_dim d1 on ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
       join customer on ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
       join date_dim d2 on c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
       join date_dim d3 on c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
       join filtered_cd1 cd1 on ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
       join filtered_cd2 cd2 on c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
       join household_demographics hd1 on ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
       join household_demographics hd2 on c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
       join customer_address ad1 on ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
       join filtered_ad2 ad2 on c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk
       join income_band ib1 on hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
       join income_band ib2 on hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
  where ss_wholesale_cost between 80 and 100
    and cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
  group by i_product_name, i_item_sk, s_store_name, s_zip,
           ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip,
           ad2.ca_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name, ad2.ca_city, ad2.ca_zip,
           d1.d_year, d2.d_year, d3.d_year
)
select cs1.product_name,
       cs1.store_name,
       cs1.store_zip,
       cs1.b_street_number,
       cs1.b_street_name,
       cs1.b_city,
       cs1.b_zip,
       cs1.c_street_number,
       cs1.c_street_name,
       cs1.c_city,
       cs1.c_zip,
       cs1.syear,
       cs1.cnt,
       cs1.s1 as s11,
       cs1.s2 as s21,
       cs1.s3 as s31,
       cs2.s1 as s12,
       cs2.s2 as s22,
       cs2.s3 as s32,
       cs2.syear,
       cs2.cnt
from cross_sales cs1
     join cross_sales cs2 on cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk
                          and cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name
                          and cs1.store_zip = cs2.store_zip
where cs1.syear = 1999
  and cs2.syear = 2000
  and cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt
order by cs1.product_name, cs1.store_name, cs2.cnt, cs1.s1, cs2.s1

WITH cs_ui AS (
  SELECT cs_item_sk
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      cs.cs_item_sk,
      sum(cs.cs_ext_list_price) AS total_list_price,
      sum(cr.cr_refunded_cash + cr.cr_reversed_charge + cr.cr_store_credit) AS total_refund
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk AND cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
  ) agg
  WHERE agg.total_list_price > 2 * agg.total_refund
),
filtered_promotion AS (
  SELECT p_promo_sk
  FROM promotion
  WHERE p_channel_email = 'Y' AND p_channel_tv = 'N' AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name
  FROM item
  WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 17 AND 27
),
filtered_ad2 AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_city, ca_zip
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_state IN ('KS', 'MN', 'NV')
),
filtered_cd AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('D', 'U', 'S') AND cd_education_status IN ('College', 'Advanced Degree')
),
cross_sales_1998 AS (
  SELECT 
    i.i_product_name AS product_name,
    i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
    s.s_store_name AS store_name,
    s.s_zip AS store_zip,
    ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
    ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
    ad1.ca_city AS b_city,

    ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
    ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
    ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
    ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,

    d2.d_year AS fsyear,

    count(*) AS cnt,
    sum(ss.ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
    sum(ss.ss_list_price) AS s2,
    sum(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND d1.d_year = 1998
  INNER JOIN cs_ui ON ss.ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk

  INNER JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
  INNER JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  INNER JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d3 ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_cd cd1 ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_cd cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_address ad1 ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_ad2 ad2 ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk

  INNER JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
  GROUP BY i.i_product_name, i.i_item_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_zip,
           ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip,

           d2.d_year, d3.d_year
),
cross_sales_1999 AS (

  INNER JOIN cs_ui ON ss.ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number

  INNER JOIN filtered_cd cd1 ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_cd cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_address ad1 ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk

  INNER JOIN income_band ib1 ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
  INNER JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
  GROUP BY i.i_product_name, i.i_item_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_zip,
           ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip,

WITH base_revenue AS (
  SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1178 AND 1189
    AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 0.45 * ss_list_price AND 0.55 * ss_list_price
  GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk
),
store_avg AS (
  SELECT ss_store_sk, AVG(revenue) AS ave
  FROM base_revenue
  GROUP BY ss_store_sk
)
SELECT s_store_name, i_item_desc, br.revenue, i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost, i_brand
FROM store
JOIN base_revenue br ON s_store_sk = br.ss_store_sk
JOIN store_avg sa ON br.ss_store_sk = sa.ss_store_sk
JOIN item ON i_item_sk = br.ss_item_sk
WHERE s_state IN ('IN', 'MI', 'WI')
  AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 83 AND 87
  AND br.revenue <= 0.1 * sa.ave
ORDER BY s_store_name, i_item_desc
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_moy BETWEEN 9 AND 11
),
store_customers AS (
  SELECT ss_customer_sk
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN filtered_dates ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 5 AND 94

  GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
),
web_customers AS (

),

  cd_education_status,

  count(*) cnt3
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk

original_query: select  i_item_desc       ,w_warehouse_name       ,d1.d_week_seq       ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is null then 1 else 0 end) no_promo       ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is not null then 1 else 0 end) promo       ,count(*) total_cnt from catalog_sales join inventory on (cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk) join warehouse on (w_warehouse_sk=inv_warehouse_sk) join item on (i_item_sk = cs_item_sk) join customer_demographics on (cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk) join household_demographics on (cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk) join date_dim d1 on (cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk) join date_dim d2 on (inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk) join date_dim d3 on (cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk) left outer join promotion on (cs_promo_sk=p_promo_sk) left outer join catalog_returns on (cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk and cr_order_number = cs_order_number) where d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq   and inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity   and d3.d_date > d1.d_date + interval '3 day'   and hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'   and d1.d_year = 2001   and cd_marital_status = 'U'   and cd_dep_count between 5 and 7   and i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')   and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100 group by i_item_desc,w_warehouse_name,d1.d_week_seq order by total_cnt desc, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d_week_seq limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_date_d1 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_date_d2 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM filtered_date_d1)
),
filtered_date_d3 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_desc
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
),
filtered_cd AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status = 'U'
    AND cd_dep_count BETWEEN 5 AND 7
),
filtered_hd AS (
  SELECT hd_demo_sk
  FROM household_demographics
  WHERE hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
),
filtered_cs AS (
  SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cs.cs_ship_date_sk,
         cs.cs_promo_sk, cs.cs_quantity
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN filtered_cd cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN filtered_hd hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
)
SELECT i_item_desc,
       w_warehouse_name,
       d1.d_week_seq,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p_promo_sk IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_promo,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo,
       COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
FROM filtered_cs cs
JOIN filtered_date_d1 d1 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_date_d3 d3 ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day'
JOIN filtered_item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN inventory inv ON cs.cs_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
  AND inv.inv_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_date_d2 WHERE d_week_seq = d1.d_week_seq)
JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
  AND cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
WHERE inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < cs.cs_quantity
GROUP BY i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d1.d_week_seq
ORDER BY total_cnt DESC, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d_week_seq

WITH sports_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category = 'Sports'
),
filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year IN (1998, 1999)
),
catalog_sales_agg AS (
  SELECT fd.d_year,
         si.i_brand_id,
         si.i_class_id,
         si.i_category_id,
         si.i_manufact_id,
         SUM(cs.cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr.cr_return_quantity, 0)) AS sales_cnt,
         SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0.0)) AS sales_amt
  FROM sports_items si
  JOIN filtered_dates fd ON 1=1
  JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = si.i_item_sk AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON (cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk AND cr.cr_reason_sk IN (7, 10, 12, 29, 45))
  WHERE cs.cs_list_price > 0 AND cs.cs_sales_price BETWEEN 0.8 * cs.cs_list_price AND 1.0 * cs.cs_list_price
  GROUP BY fd.d_year, si.i_brand_id, si.i_class_id, si.i_category_id, si.i_manufact_id
),
store_sales_agg AS (
  SELECT fd.d_year,
         si.i_brand_id,
         si.i_class_id,
         si.i_category_id,
         si.i_manufact_id,
         SUM(ss.ss_quantity - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) AS sales_cnt,
         SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS sales_amt
  FROM sports_items si
  JOIN filtered_dates fd ON 1=1
  JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = si.i_item_sk AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON (ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND sr.sr_reason_sk IN (7, 10, 12, 29, 45))
  WHERE ss.ss_list_price > 0 AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 0.8 * ss.ss_list_price AND 1.0 * ss.ss_list_price
  GROUP BY fd.d_year, si.i_brand_id, si.i_class_id, si.i_category_id, si.i_manufact_id
),
web_sales_agg AS (
  SELECT fd.d_year,
         si.i_brand_id,
         si.i_class_id,
         si.i_category_id,
         si.i_manufact_id,
         SUM(ws.ws_quantity - COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0)) AS sales_cnt,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS sales_amt
  FROM sports_items si
  JOIN filtered_dates fd ON 1=1
  JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = si.i_item_sk AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON (ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND wr.wr_reason_sk IN (7, 10, 12, 29, 45))
  WHERE ws.ws_list_price > 0 AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 0.8 * ws.ws_list_price AND 1.0 * ws.ws_list_price
  GROUP BY fd.d_year, si.i_brand_id, si.i_class_id, si.i_category_id, si.i_manufact_id
),
all_sales AS (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, sales_cnt, sales_amt
  FROM catalog_sales_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, sales_cnt, sales_amt
  FROM store_sales_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, sales_cnt, sales_amt
  FROM web_sales_agg
),
aggregated_sales AS (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id,
         SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt,
         SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt
  FROM all_sales
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
)
SELECT prev_yr.d_year AS prev_year,
       curr_yr.d_year AS year,
       curr_yr.i_brand_id,
       curr_yr.i_class_id,
       curr_yr.i_category_id,
       curr_yr.i_manufact_id,
       prev_yr.sales_cnt AS prev_yr_cnt,
       curr_yr.sales_cnt AS curr_yr_cnt,
       curr_yr.sales_cnt - prev_yr.sales_cnt AS sales_cnt_diff,
       curr_yr.sales_amt - prev_yr.sales_amt AS sales_amt_diff
FROM aggregated_sales curr_yr
JOIN aggregated_sales prev_yr ON curr_yr.i_brand_id = prev_yr.i_brand_id
                              AND curr_yr.i_class_id = prev_yr.i_class_id
                              AND curr_yr.i_category_id = prev_yr.i_category_id
                              AND curr_yr.i_manufact_id = prev_yr.i_manufact_id
WHERE curr_yr.d_year = 1999
  AND prev_yr.d_year = 1998
  AND prev_yr.sales_cnt > 0
  AND CAST(curr_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17,2)) / CAST(prev_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17,2)) < 0.9
ORDER BY sales_cnt_diff, sales_amt_diff
LIMIT 100

在aggregated_sales CTE中，当前对all_sales执行GROUP BY聚合，但all_sales已经是三个预聚合结果的UNION ALL。由于各*_sales_agg CTE已按(d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id)分组，UNION ALL后相同分组键的记录来自不同渠道(catalog/store/web)，需要再次聚合合并。但可以利用Merge Append的有序性优化：在各*_sales_agg CTE末尾增加ORDER BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id，使UNION ALL的输出天然有序，aggregated_sales的GROUP BY可转换为流式聚合(GroupAggregate)而非HashAggregate，减少内存消耗和排序开销。

WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    ca_state AS ctr_state,
    SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM catalog_returns
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998
  INNER JOIN customer_address ON cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
),
state_threshold AS (
  SELECT 
    ctr_state,
    AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS threshold
  FROM customer_total_return
  GROUP BY ctr_state
)
SELECT 
  c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name,
  ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number,
  ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset,
  ca_location_type, ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
INNER JOIN state_threshold st ON ctr1.ctr_state = st.ctr_state AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > st.threshold
INNER JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'IL'
ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name,
  ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number,
  ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset,
  ca_location_type, ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100

WITH date_filter AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_month_seq IN (
    SELECT d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date IN ('1998-03-05','1998-06-15','1998-09-12','1998-10-31')
  )
),
item_filter AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 45
),
sr_items AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
         SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty
  FROM store_returns sr
  INNER JOIN item_filter i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN date_filter d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
    AND sr.sr_return_amt BETWEEN 141 * sr.sr_return_quantity AND 170 * sr.sr_return_quantity
    AND sr.sr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62)
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id
),
cr_items AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
         SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  INNER JOIN item_filter i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN date_filter d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
    AND cr.cr_return_amount BETWEEN 141 * cr.cr_return_quantity AND 170 * cr.cr_return_quantity
    AND cr.cr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62)
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id
),
wr_items AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
         SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS wr_item_qty
  FROM web_returns wr
  INNER JOIN item_filter i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN date_filter d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
    AND wr.wr_return_amt BETWEEN 141 * wr.wr_return_quantity AND 170 * wr.wr_return_quantity
    AND wr.wr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62)
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id
)
SELECT sr_items.item_id,
       sr_item_qty,
       sr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS sr_dev,
       cr_item_qty,
       cr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS cr_dev,
       wr_item_qty,
       wr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS wr_dev,
       (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 AS average
FROM sr_items
INNER JOIN cr_items ON sr_items.item_id = cr_items.item_id
INNER JOIN wr_items ON sr_items.item_id = wr_items.item_id
ORDER BY sr_items.item_id, sr_item_qty
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_web_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    ws_web_page_sk,
    ws_item_sk,
    ws_order_number,
    ws_sold_date_sk,
    ws_quantity,
    ws_sales_price,
    ws_net_profit
  FROM web_sales
  WHERE 
    ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
),
filtered_date AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998
),
filtered_address AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
    AND ca_state IN ('GA', 'IN', 'VA', 'MT', 'NM', 'OR', 'IL', 'OH')
),
filtered_cd AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE 
    (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree')
    OR (cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College')
    OR (cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')
)
SELECT 
  substring(r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
  avg(ws_quantity),
  avg(wr_refunded_cash),
  avg(wr_fee)
FROM filtered_web_sales ws
JOIN filtered_date d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk 
  AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN filtered_cd cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
JOIN filtered_cd cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
  AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
  AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
JOIN filtered_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
JOIN reason r ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
WHERE 
  (
    (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd1.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' 
     AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
    OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' 
        AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
    OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' 
        AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
  )
  AND (
    (ca.ca_state IN ('GA', 'IN', 'VA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
    OR (ca.ca_state IN ('MT', 'NM', 'OR') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
    OR (ca.ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'OH') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
  )
GROUP BY r_reason_desc
ORDER BY 
  substring(r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
  avg(ws_quantity),
  avg(wr_refunded_cash),
  avg(wr_fee)
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_sales AS (

    ws.ws_quantity,

    SELECT 'S', 'College', 50.00, 100.00
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'U', '2 yr Degree', 150.00, 200.00
  ) cd_match
  WHERE ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN cd_match.price_low AND cd_match.price_high
)

  substring(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
  avg(fs.ws_quantity),

INNER JOIN reason r 
  ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc

original_query: select  c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name, count(*) as cnt FROM store_sales, store_returns, web_sales, date_dim d1, date_dim d2, item, customer, customer_address, household_demographics WHERE ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND sr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Sports') AND sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_date between d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + interval '90' day) AND ca_state in ('IA', 'KS', 'MD', 'MO', 'OK') AND d1.d_year = 2000 AND hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20 AND hd_buy_potential = '0-500' AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 38 * 0.01 AND 58 * 0.01 GROUP BY c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name ORDER BY cnt ;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2000
),
filtered_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Sports')
),
filtered_customers AS (
  SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
  FROM customer c
  INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('IA', 'KS', 'MD', 'MO', 'OK')
    AND hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20
    AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '0-500'
),
qualified_returns AS (
  SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_ticket_number, sr.sr_returned_date_sk
  FROM store_returns sr
  INNER JOIN filtered_dates d1 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_items fi ON sr.sr_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
)
SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM qualified_returns qr
INNER JOIN store_sales ss 
  ON qr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number 
  AND qr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_customers c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN web_sales ws 
  ON ss.ss_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk 
  AND qr.sr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_dates d1 ON qr.sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
WHERE d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '90' day)
  AND ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.38 AND 0.58
GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
ORDER BY cnt
